title: PixelateImageOperation native QEMU byte comparison (#4908)
qemu_command: qemu-i386 -cpu pentium3 (via hb.run; timeout=60s, 2400 MiB scope; fallback RLIMIT_AS if session bus unavailable)
operation_constructor: 0x00bbcf30 called for each case to initialize PixelateImageOperation vtable; direct core call is then used
image_descriptor_constructor: 0x009a8b60; rect=(0,0,W,H), zero flag, source pixels copied to the allocated +0x10 buffer; destination output read back through its post-call +0x10
resize_wrapper: 0x00bcb5e0; the core calls smoothing=true for reduction and smoothing=false for centered expansion
allocator_control: CRT/Picasa allocation shims from hb.py plus a HeapReAlloc shim; allocated bytes prefilled with 0xA5 in the 19-case matrix

falsification_control.result: same pixels under both allocator fill patterns and repeat
